method: Compared model-selection claims with current OpenAI and Anthropic official documentation, an OpenAI agent cost-quality cookbook and RouterBench; executed eight offline editorial-boundary assertions and every Python fence. No provider request or benchmark call was made.

observations.trace: Removed universal token-length/model-tier and cascade-percentage heuristics; corrected the synthetic cascade break-even from 50% to 85% for the declared parameters; separated response structure, semantic/task acceptance, provider errors, safety and authorization.

limitations: No candidate model quality benchmark, judge calibration, provider request, production route, or side-effecting shadow traffic was run.
Historical routing cost numbers are local arithmetic over assumptions; they are not real prices, token usage or task outcomes.
The historic 14.4x API/UI token comparison used non-equivalent execution and success criteria and cannot establish model-routing gains.
